articles.title: SBI buys 20% stake in Indonesia's Ajaib for $270 million to expand yen stablecoin in Southeast Asia
articles.snippet: The Japanese financial giant is acquiring a 20% stake in the Indonesian online brokerage to build a cross-border, blockchain-based settlement network.

articles.title: Visa doubles down on South Korea with Upbit operator Dunamu on stablecoin payments
articles.snippet: Following a deal with Shinhan Financial, the global payments giant is widening its footprint in Asia’s major crypto hub through South Korea's largest exchange.

articles.title: Chelsea FC gets a stablecoin sponsor after UK FCA warning to clubs
articles.snippet: According to Circle, the USDC stablecoin name will appear on the front of club jerseys for Chelsea’s upcoming football season.

articles.title: Bullish provides USD.AI $100M stablecoin facility for GPU-backed lending
articles.snippet: The institutional crypto exchange is providing $100 million in stablecoin liquidity to support loans backed by AI computing infrastructure.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin pumps, Wall Street does the paperwork
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s $80,000 rebound lifts crypto stocks as Circle, Strategy and Solana show how capital markets, stablecoins and onchain growth are driving crypto’s recovery.
